svg.title: 심야 택시 기사 — Makcha: Seoul Survivor
svg.desc: Late-Night Taxi Driver. Original quarter-view pixel-art character concept, on an 80 by 80 pixel grid with a transparent background. See generation-prompts.json for the design specification.
svg.metadata: Project artwork, AI-assisted with Codex and ImageGen. CC BY-SA 4.0. Native grid: 80 by 80; at most 32 RGBA colors; vector pixel paths with no embedded bitmap.
